# Controllers Instructions — MY Music Project

> Part of the GitHub Copilot instructions set.
> See also: `copilot-instructions.md`, `repositories-instructions.md`

All controllers live in `web api/WebAopiShop/Controllers/`.
Base route pattern: `[Route("api/[controller]")]`

---

## UserController

Route: `api/User`
Service: `IUserService`

| Method | Route | Auth | Request | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | Admin only | — | `IEnumerable<UserDTO>` |
| GET | `/{id}` | Authorized | — | `UserDTO` |
| POST | `/Login` | Anonymous | `UserInputDTO` (body) | `{ user: UserDTO, token: string }` |
| POST | `/Register` | Anonymous | `UserInputDTO` (body) | `{ user: UserDTO, token: string }` (201) |
| PUT | `/{id}` | Authorized | `UserInputDTO` (body) | `UserDTO` |
| DELETE | `/{id}` | Admin only | — | 204 NoContent |
| PATCH | `/{id}/theme` | Authorized | `string` (body, JSON) | 204 NoContent |

### Key behaviors

- Login and Register both set `auth_token` HttpOnly cookie (1 hour expiry, `SameSite=None`, `Secure=true`).
- Login returns 401 if credentials don't match.
- Register returns 400 `"Password too weak"` if password strength < 2.
- PUT returns 400 `"Password too weak"` on weak password, then fetches and returns updated user.
- PATCH theme accepts `"LIGHT"` or `"DARK"` (case-insensitive in service); returns 400 for invalid values.
- `UserInputDTO` → manually mapped to `User` entity in controller (not AutoMapper).

## SongController

Route: `api/Song`
Service: `ISongService`

| Method | Route | Auth | Request | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | Anonymous | Query: `artistId?`, `Description?`, `minPrice?`, `maxPrice?`, `position=1`, `skip=10` | `{ songs: SongDTO[], total: int }` |
| GET | `/{id}` | Anonymous | — | `SongDTO` |
| POST | `/` | Admin only | `Song` entity (body) | `SongDTO` (201) |
| PUT | `/{id}` | Admin only | `Song` entity (body) | `bool` (200) |
| DELETE | `/{id}` | Admin only | — | 204 NoContent |

### Key behaviors

- GET list: returns `{ songs: [], total: 0 }` (never 404) when empty.
- POST triggers background AI genre tagging (`TagGenreInBackgroundAsync` in service) — fire-and-forget.
- PUT returns 404 with message if song not found.
- `position` = page number (1-based), `skip` = page size.

---

## ArtistController

Route: `api/Artist`
Service: `IArtistService`

| Method | Route | Auth | Request | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/` | Anonymous | — | `List<ArtistDTO>` |
| GET | `/{id}` | Anonymous | — | `ArtistDTO` |
| POST | `/` | Admin only | `ArtistDTO` (body) | `ArtistDTO` (201) |
| PUT | `/{id}` | Admin only | `ArtistDTO` (body) | `ArtistDTO` |
| DELETE | `/{id}` | Admin only | — | 204 NoContent |

### Key behaviors

- GET all: returns 204 NoContent if no artists (not empty array).
- GET by id: returns 404 if not found.
- POST: returns 400 if service returns null.
- PUT: returns 404 if artist not found.

---

## OrderController

Route: `api/Order`
Service: `IOrderService`

| Method | Route | Auth | Request | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/{id}` | Authorized | — | `OrderDTO` |
| POST | `/` | Authorized | `OrderDTO` (body) | `OrderDTO` (201) |
| GET | `/user/{UserId}` | Authorized | — | `IEnumerable<OrderDTO>` |

### Key behaviors

- GET by id: returns 204 if not found.
- POST: service validates `OrderSum` matches sum of song prices — throws `Exception` on mismatch (caught by `ErrorHandlingMiddleware`).
- GET by user: returns 404 with message if no orders found.

---

## AdminController

Route: `api/Admin`
Service: `IUserService`

| Method | Route | Auth | Request | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/Login` | Anonymous | `{ Password: string }` (body) | `{ success: true, token: string }` |

### Key behaviors

- Hardcoded password check (`"admin123"`) — **do not use in production without replacing**.
- On success: sets `auth_token` cookie (same options as UserController) and returns token in body.
- Returns `{ success: false }` 401 on wrong password.
- Token generated by `UserService.GenerateAdminToken()` which creates a JWT with `Role = "Admin"`.

---

## ChatController

Route: `api/Chat`
Dependencies: `UserContext` (direct), `IHttpClientFactory`

| Method | Route | Auth | Request | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/` | None | `{ Message: string, History: List<object> }` (body) | `{ Reply: string }` |

### Key behaviors

- Fetches real song list from DB (`_userContext.Songs`) and forwards to Python AI service at `http://localhost:8001/chat`.
- Forwards full payload: message, history, products.
- Returns Python service error with original status code on failure.
- Note: has triple `[HttpPost]` attribute — redundant, can be cleaned up.

## PasswordController

Route: `api/Password`
Service: `IPasswordService`

Used internally for password strength checking.
`CheckPassword` entity defines strength levels.

---

## General Controller Rules

1. Never inject a Repository directly into a Controller — always go through a Service.
2. Always return `ActionResult<T>` for typed responses.
3. Use `NoContent()` (204) for empty results on GET, `NotFound()` (404) when the resource definitively doesn't exist.
4. Catch nothing in controllers — let `ErrorHandlingMiddleware` handle unhandled exceptions.
5. Map `UserInputDTO` → `User` entity manually in UserController (existing pattern — keep consistent).
6. For new controllers: add `[ApiController]` + `[Route("api/[controller]")]` attributes, register service in `Program.cs`.
